comment: Two mechanisms. 'priority_draws': chance to force a specific room (or one of a named set) into slot 3 whenever it is draftable. 'category_biases': conditional biases that force a category re-deal with the given chance while their condition holds (King's Chess Piece variants, constellations, room auras). Chances are fractions.
